text:
Blockchain technology is like a shared digital notebook that everyone can see but no one can secretly change. Instead of one person or company keeping the records, the information is spread out across many computers. Each page of this notebook, called a "block," holds a group of transactions. Once a page is filled and verified, it is locked in place using complex math (cryptography) that links it securely to the previous page. Because of this linking, it is nearly impossible to alter past records or commit fraud without everyone noticing.
